jobs.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
In the initial months, you'll be working closely with the founding team, gradually taking ownership of central components.

We are on the brink of something monumental, anticipating a tidal wave of traffic. You'll be at the forefront of ensuring our systems not only handle the influx but thrive under the pressure.

We focus on performance and reliability, our traffic is live and our latency is the most important metric we need to watch. We work very closely with the backend team, helping everyone to bring code in production. Automation is key as it is for most of our industry, if you need to repeat a task, automate it; for everything.


As a Lead SRE, your day-to-day will include:


Vision and leadership

You’ll define and lead the long-term infrastructure vision and roadmap, ensuring amo’s systems remain reliable, scalable, and secure as we grow globally. You’ll guide a small, high-performing team of SRE engineers, setting a clear direction while staying close to execution. You’ll cultivate a culture of reliability, ownership, and technical excellence, one that balances speed and stability every day.

System Design and Management

You’ll designing and maintaining distributed databases at large scale across multiple clusters (ScyllaDB). Along with testing, scaling, designing high throughput monitoring infrastructure to handle 1M+ series per second.

Automation and Efficiency

Our north star is to eradicate every manual step, automate everything from the ground up, and make it as quick as possible. That means automating everything from monitoring dashboards to database installations or cluster management. Including automated Kubernetes Pod Autoscaler to achieve close to 90% CPU usage per machine while maintaining high-quality services and containing costs.

Backend Team Partnership

Partnering with software engineers is not a concept or part of a process, it’s our daily life, making us part of the engineering team as much as any other. And working with our partners (GCP, ScyllaDB, Redpanda …) to help us push their products to the limit.

Software Engineering and Development

You’ll code - being SRE at amo means being a Software Engineer. It also means building CI/CD pipelines, and bringing to production new concepts, new tools to help the company grow faster.


Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong understanding of system architecture and software development.

  • Proficiency in at least one low-level language, ideally Rust or Go.

  • Strong knowledge with monitoring and alerting tools.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms and infrastructure, including strong proficiency in AWS and/or GCP.

  • Proven success in scaling high-traffic production environments with a focus on reliability and performance.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence cross-functional teams.

  • Pragmatic, hands-on, and comfortable moving between strategy and execution.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

      We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.


We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

  • Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home.

  • Help with french paperwork like opening a french social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare) and more.

  • French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts. This commitment to expertise is an expectation of every team member.

The backend team at amo is responsible for both server side and the backbone of the client as we believe it makes more sense to have one team handle both ends of the same topics (network, data modelling, management and synchronisation, etc).


As a Backend Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

Crafting the Future

Developing systems that handle massive traffic, data, and an unmatched rate of scaling. Your toolkit? Carefully chosen cutting-edge technologies, code that's practically poetry, and systems that effortlessly scale horizontally.

Cross-Platform Harmony

In addition to server side development, you will participate in the evolution and maintenance of a Rust component that we share between iOS and Android and that deals mostly with networking, data synchronisation and data-oriented feature logic that benefit from being written just once. You will collaborate with iOS and Android engineers to maintain a unified codebase, enabling consistent experiences across platforms. You’ll also bridge the gap between mobile development and backend infrastructure for a seamless user journey.

Feature Development

Participating in brainstorming sessions and discussions to design and implement features that set us apart in the market.

Continuous Improvement

We love learning from each other, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, bringing fresh ideas to the table. So you'll be contributing to our culture of continuous improvement, where learning and growing are integral parts of the journey.

Owning your scope

You will be responsible for monitoring analytics and managing system crashes. We value engineers who take ownership of their scope, and proactively address issues and triage bug fixes.


Your Skills & Experience

We are hiring multiple engineers of varying levels, so please indicate your years of experience on the application form to apply for the appropriate position.

With your high-level vantage point, you’ll drive and maintain a flexible design system to support rapid iteration and prototyping.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Rust)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Looking for someone to join us as one of the early members of the Backend team. In the initial months, you'll be working closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central components and features. Given our early stage, we're seeking versatile engineers, comfortable contributing to various aspects of the company's foundation.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts. This commitment to expertise is an expectation of every team member.

The backend team at amo is responsible for both server side and the backbone of the client as we believe it makes more sense to have one team handle both ends of the same topics (network, data modelling, management and synchronisation, etc).


As a Backend Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

 

Crafting the Future

Developing systems that handle massive traffic, data, and an unmatched rate of scaling. Your toolkit? Carefully chosen cutting-edge technologies, code that's practically poetry, and systems that effortlessly scale horizontally.

 

Cross-Platform Harmony

In addition to server side development, you will participate in the evolution and maintenance of a Rust component that we share between iOS and Android and that deals mostly with networking, data synchronisation and data-oriented feature logic that benefit from being written just once. You will collaborate with iOS and Android engineers to maintain a unified codebase, enabling consistent experiences across platforms. You’ll also bridge the gap between mobile development and backend infrastructure for a seamless user journey.

 

Feature Development

Participating in brainstorming sessions and discussions to design and implement features that set us apart in the market.

 

Continuous Improvement

We love learning from each other, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, bringing fresh ideas to the table. So you'll be contributing to our culture of continuous improvement, where learning and growing are integral parts of the journey.

 

Owning your scope

You will be responsible for monitoring analytics and managing system crashes. We value engineers who take ownership of their scope, and proactively address issues and triage bug fixes.

Your Skills & Experience

  1. Production experience with Rust, or strong background in systems-level languages (C++, C, OCaml).

  2. Hands-on experience with distributed systems in production (Kafka, Redpanda, ScyllaDB, Cassandra, or similar).

  3. Strong instincts about consumer social products - what makes them work, what makes them fail.

  4. French isn't required. Neither is perfect English - we'll help you ramp up if needed.

Life at amo

 

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

 

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

 

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

      We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

       

We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

  • Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home.

  • Help with french paperwork like opening a french social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare) and more.

  • French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life.

jobs.title: Balkans Content Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We’re looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what’s trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in the Balkan countries (and keep it there).

You’ll be the person bringing internet culture from the respective countries into the heart of our Paris office—creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app.

If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading.

You are:

  • Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative.

  • A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off.

  • Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you’d ever admit publicly.

  • Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better.

  • Deeply tuned into Balkan memes, humour, and online culture.

  • Fluent in your respective language and lived in that country.

  • Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team.

  • Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented.

What You’ll Do:

  • Grow Bump in the Balkan countries (yep, you’ll actually own this).

  • Lead all content + creator efforts for the Balkan market.

  • Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of Balkan creators.

  • Run influencer campaigns with top Balkan creators and micro-influencers.

  • Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance.

  • Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page.

  • Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine.

  • Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product.

  • Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump.

  • Support launches, events, and Balkan-focused activations.

Requirements:

  • 1–5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator, we care more about your work than your title).

  • Experience making content for ads (UGC especially).

  • Experience managing creators or giving creative feedback.

  • Deep knowledge of TikTok/IG trends and the Balkan creator landscape.

  • A Balkan language and English language proficiency.

  • Experience living in any of the Balkan countries.

  • Must be willing to work in person in Paris.

Why Join Bump?

  • Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast.

  • Own the entire Balkan market for one of the world’s fastest-growing consumer apps.

  • Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth.

  • Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try.

  • Build a content engine from scratch and shape how Bump shows up in the Balkans.

  • We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
amo is growing quickly: more users, more product surfaces, more features, and more data every day. We are looking for a senior data generalist to build the systems that make this data reliable, accessible, and useful across product, business, and compliance needs.

This role is for someone who understands data pipelines deeply, knows the modern data ecosystem, and can work across engines, storage formats, query layers, validation, orchestration, and production integration.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines.

  • Move production data into archival/data lake storage safely and observably.

  • Improve quality, reliability, and observability of derived datasets.

  • Design validations for freshness, completeness, schema correctness, and data quality.

  • Build reusable datasets that reduce one-off data extraction and aggregation work.

  • Optimize queries and data processing jobs for correctness, latency, and cost.

  • Prototype in the right tools, then integrate scoped production experiments with amo’s systems where needed.

Must Have

  • Senior-level experience building and operating data pipelines.

  • Strong Python and SQL.

  • Production experience with Python or Scala.

  • Experience with PySpark, Spark SQL, Spark Streaming, Parquet, and Iceberg.

  • Strong understanding of batch and stream processing.

  • Query optimization experience.

  • Familiarity with data engine internals and distributed data systems.

  • Experience with data lakes, table/storage formats, and derived datasets.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Flink or similar stream processing systems.

  • Experience with ML training or inference pipelines.

  • Familiarity with ranking, recommendations, embeddings, or entity resolution.

  • Experience with privacy-sensitive data systems, GDPR workflows, or data deletion/export pipelines.

jobs.title: Indonesian Content Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in Indonesia (and keep it there).

You'll be the person bringing internet culture from Indonesia into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app.

If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading.

You are:

  • Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative.

  • A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off.

  • Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly.

  • Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better.

  • Deeply tuned into Indonesian memes, humour, and online culture.

  • Fluent in Indonesian and English, and have lived in Indonesia.

  • Excited to work onsite if in Paris, with a fast-moving team.

  • Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented.

What You'll Do:

  • Grow Bump in Indonesia (yep, you'll actually own this).

  • Lead all content + creator efforts for the Indonesian market.

  • Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of Indonesian creators.

  • Run influencer campaigns with top Indonesian creators and micro-influencers.

  • Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance.

  • Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page.

  • Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine.

  • Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product.

  • Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump.

  • Support launches, events, and Indonesia-focused activations.

Requirements:

  • 1–5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator, we care more about your work than your title).

  • Experience making content for ads (UGC especially).

  • Experience managing creators or giving creative feedback.

  • Deep knowledge of TikTok/IG trends and the Indonesian creator landscape.

  • Indonesian language and English language proficiency.

  • Must be from Indonesia.

  • Must be willing to work in person in Paris.

Why Join Bump?

  • Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast.

  • Own the entire Indonesian market for one of the world's fastest-growing consumer apps.

  • Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth.

  • Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try.

  • Build a content engine from scratch and shape how Bump shows up in Indonesia.

  • We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly.

jobs.title: Location Data engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

jobs.title: Portugal Content Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in Portugal (and keep it there).

You'll be the person bringing internet culture from Portugal into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app.

If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading.

You are:

  • Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative.

  • A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off.

  • Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly.

  • Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better.

  • Deeply tuned into Portuguese memes, humour, and online culture.

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, and have lived in Portugal.

  • Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team.

  • Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented.

What You'll Do:

  • Grow Bump in Portugal (yep, you'll actually own this).

  • Lead all content + creator efforts for the Portuguese market.

  • Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of Portuguese creators.

  • Run influencer campaigns with top Portuguese creators and micro-influencers.

  • Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance.

  • Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page.

  • Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine.

  • Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product.

  • Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump.

  • Support launches, events, and Portugal-focused activations.

Requirements:

  • 1–5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator, we care more about your work than your title).

  • Experience making content for ads (UGC especially).

  • Experience managing creators or giving creative feedback.

  • Deep knowledge of TikTok/IG trends and the Portuguese creator landscape.

  • Portuguese language and English language proficiency.

  • Experience living in Portugal.

  • Must be willing to work in person in Paris.

Why Join Bump?

  • Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast.

  • Own the entire Portuguese market for one of the world's fastest-growing consumer apps.

  • Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth.

  • Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try.

  • Build a content engine from scratch and shape how Bump shows up in Portugal.

  • We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly.

We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, owning the user-facing web at amo. For many people, the web is where they first meet our apps: a link shared by a friend, opened in a messenger or a social feed, often seconds before they decide whether to download. That moment matters a lot to us.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team on the surfaces that bring new people into our products, gradually taking ownership of a growing part of our consumer web experience. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable working across product, engineering and growth.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

Consumer Web Experiences

Building fast, beautiful, conversion-focused web experiences that show off our apps at their best, from the first link someone taps to the moment they open the app. You’ll turn designs into polished UI that loads instantly on any device and in any in-app browser, and you’ll care about every millisecond and every pixel.

Deep Linking & App Entry

Owning the bridge between web and app: Universal Links, App Links, deferred deep linking, attribution, and App Clips. Whether the user already has the app or not, every link should take them exactly where they expect to go.

Sharing & Rich Previews

Making everything shared from our apps look great everywhere it lands. That includes generating dynamic OG metadata and preview images at scale, and iterating on what gets shared and how it’s presented, based on what actually converts.

Analytics & Experimentation

Designing and maintaining our event tracking taxonomy (Amplitude) so that the data is consistent, well organized and trusted across teams. You’ll instrument funnels end-to-end, run rigorous A/B tests, and turn the results into decisions.

Growth Initiatives

Identifying and shipping new ways to improve acquisition and conversion. We expect you to look at the funnel, form your own hypotheses, build, measure, and then either scale or drop the idea. You’ll be an active contributor to the roadmap, not just its executor.

Owning your scope

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.

  • Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend. Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus.

  • Passion and experience building consumer-facing products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped!

AI as a multiplier

AI is part of how we build every day. We’re looking for engineers with a real grasp of these tools, who use them to multiply their output and not to make up for missing expertise. You should be able to drive an agent through a complex change, judge what it produces, spot where it’s subtly wrong, and stand behind every line that ships.

The bar

We’re looking for exceptional engineers, and we set the bar high on purpose. In return, you’ll get real ownership of a high-impact surface, products used by millions of people, a team that ships in days rather than quarters, a modern stack with top-tier tooling, and colleagues who will push you to grow.

Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

Workflows & Data Pipelines

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Data Modeling & Visualization

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

Maps & Geospatial Data

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.

  • Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl, or similar) is a big plus.

jobs.title: Brand Director
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to.


We're looking for a Brand Lead who writes like a dream and ships like a machine. Someone who's run global campaigns at a top agency, knows what a great brief feels like, and is ready to trade the client side of the table for owning the whole thing.


You'll shape how amo sounds, looks and shows up everywhere, from a two-word push notification to a launch film watched in fifteen countries.

What you'll do:

  • Own the amo voice. Write it, guard it, and make it better every week. App copy, launch posts, store listings, social, scripts, the little lines that make people smile.

  • Run global campaigns end to end. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond.

  • Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. You know how to get their best work because you've been on their side of the table.

  • Make the brand local without making it boring. Adapt ideas so they land in Paris, London, LA and Seoul, not just translate them.

  • Measure what the brand is really doing. Set up and run brand tracking across our markets, following awareness, consideration and perception over time, and turn what you learn into the next brief.

  • Work in days, not weeks. Spot a moment on Tuesday, have a campaign live on Thursday, learn from it on Friday.

  • Sweat the details. Easter eggs, onboarding screens, the name of a feature. Small words do big work here.

What that may look like:

Kicking off a campaign with an agency for our next market launch, and setting up the tracker that tells us a month later whether people there know who we are and like what they see.

Who you are:

  • A writer first. You can make a headline sing and kill your darlings without blinking. Your portfolio proves it.

  • Agency-trained. You've spent real time at a creative agency and worked on brands people actually know. You've sat in the pitch, survived the feedback round and shipped anyway.

  • Global from day one. You've led or played a key role in campaigns that ran across several markets at once, and you know what changes (and what never should) from one country to the next.

  • Fast and opinionated. Conviction over consensus. You'd rather put out something great today than something perfect next month.

  • Fluent in internet. You know what's trending before it trends, and you can tell the difference between a moment worth joining and one worth skipping.

  • Bilingual or better is a plus. English is our working language. French, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean or Japanese would make us very happy.

Bonus points if:

You've worked on a consumer app, built a brand from scratch, or have a group chat that's funnier than most ad campaigns.

Why amo:

  • You'll own it. No account director, no client sign-off chain. Your ideas go from your head to millions of phones.

  • You'll move fast. We make decisions quickly and learn from mistakes even quicker. Intense, but healthy.

  • You'll be in good company. Over half the team is international, with 25 nationalities and counting. One in four of us moved cities or countries to be here.

  • You'll grow x10. Colleagues across product, design, engineering and growth will challenge your work every day, and you'll do the same to theirs.

  • You'll have backing. We're supported by some of the best tier-1 investors in the world and growing at a pace our space hasn't seen in years.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office is as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

  • We reimburse your commuting expenses 50%.

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in the summer and one week in the winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). This enables everyone to actually disconnect and enjoy their vacation. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. Per French standard, we also offer another 4 weeks to allow team members to choose when they want to take time off.

How to apply:

Send us your CV and a portfolio, plus one thing you'd rewrite on our website or in our app, and why. Keep it short. We'll know.
